config.name: ch3_estimate_update_rate_sensitivity
config.description: Sensitivity of exact-risk adaptive scrub schedules to external estimate lag and session-limited update cadence.
config.edge_rule: For unavailable history at the beginning of the series, clamp the source index to 0, identical to delayed_1h.
config.admissibility_rule: A variant is admissible if P_mission <= 0.01 on the full five-year series evaluated against true nu(t).
config.threshold_rule: For age sweeps, the threshold is the largest lag that remains admissible. For session sweeps, a cadence is admissible only if every phase is admissible; the reported limiting value is the worst phase.
config.pre_registered_prediction: With frozen one-hour calibration, sensitivity is expected between 3 and 6 hours of lag; U=6 h session-limited operation is expected to be borderline. Reoptimized variants may remain admissible by spending additional passes.
